claim: On January 9, 2024 the Quick create record and the Create record wizard began to support creating geoproximity routing records. Before that, geoproximity routing came with Route 53 traffic flow (added September 1, 2017), and the July 19, 2023 History row still described Local Zones with geoproximity routing as traffic flow only.

evidence.quote: January 9, 2024 You can now use the Quick create record or the Create record wizard to create geoproximity routing records.
July 19, 2023 You can now use Local Zones with geoproximity routing (traffic flow only) after you enable them.
September 1, 2017 If you're using Route 53 traffic flow, you can now use geoproximity routing, which lets you route traffic based on the physical distance between your users and your resources.

note: fr-0079 and fr-0081 (requests-13). The old state is quoted from the July 19, 2023 History row, scoped as written there (Local Zones with geoproximity routing, traffic flow only). The What's New post of 2024-01-10 says 'Route 53 previously offered geoproximity routing only within traffic flow', but its page is disallowed by robots.txt and in the saved What's New API snapshot that sentence ends inside an HTML link, so it cannot pass M4. The geoproximity page still says the maps are available only with Traffic Flow.
